leads.headline: Pacific nations forge climate bloc
leads.body: Pacific island nations began forming their own climate coalition after COP31 ended without an overarching deal. The Antalya Pact never mentioned "fossil fuels"; 90+ nations rejected it.

leads.headline: Huang returns; markets rocket
leads.body: Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO eleven days after resigning, amid pressure from Trump and investors. Nvidia rose 31% and the Nasdaq gained 6.5%.

leads.headline: Kyiv draws red lines
leads.body: Kyiv rejected legal recognition of Russia's occupation at the Stockholm summit. Geneva talks produced a "refined framework" from Trump's 28-point plan.

leads.headline: US targets Maduro's cartel
leads.body: The US designated the alleged Maduro-led cartel a terrorist organisation. The USS Gerald R. Ford group is in the Caribbean; boat strikes have killed at least 83 people.

leads.headline: Banten fire: search goes on
leads.body: Police confirmed 24 dead in Saturday's Milkita factory fire in Banten. Rescuers searched unstable wreckage for ~30 missing workers.

leads.headline: Manchester concert cleared
leads.body: Police evacuated 12,000 people from a concert venue in Manchester. An unknown substance was detected in the air.

leads.headline: APEC peace declaration
leads.body: Trump, Xi and Putin issued a symbolic joint declaration in Shenzhen. It focused on reducing nuclear risk and reforming the United Nations.

briefs.headline: EU's 22nd sanctions package
briefs.body: The proposal targets ~60 more Russian banks and 70+ more shadow-fleet vessels. All 27 EU states must approve it unanimously.

briefs.headline: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler
briefs.body: The $43.9B all-stock deal is the largest cybersecurity acquisition ever. Zscaler holders receive a 34% premium.

briefs.headline: Parastoo Ahmadi sentenced
briefs.body: Ahmadi and four production-team members were sentenced to 74 lashes each for a virtual concert without hijab.

briefs.headline: Verstappen wins Las Vegas GP
briefs.body: His 75th career win came by 0.639s, ahead of Norris and Piastri. The race saw 35 lead changes and 352 overtakes.

briefs.headline: Kanton Island evacuated
briefs.body: All 40–50 residents were moved to Tarawa on 24 hours' notice, with El Niño and poor housing cited by Kiribati's government.

briefs.headline: Landmark ICJ ruling: Myanmar
briefs.body: The ICJ's first-ever state genocide finding orders reparations and safe Rohingya return. Enforcement debate continues.
